text:
marie: FYI shadow CI on PR 21399 showed a regression in the microbench suite, tail latency up ~18% on the kv-batcher path.
perf-bot: shadow job: pr-21399 @branch=feature/kv-batch-heuristic-shim; baseline=main
perf-bot: results summary:
```
microbench/kvcache_hit_rate: baseline=0.87 -> pr=0.71 (-18%)
microbench/tail_latency_p95: baseline=24.1ms -> pr=28.4ms (+17.8%)
microbench/batch_throughput: baseline=1025 -> pr=1001 (-2.3%)
thresholds: tail_latency_p95 (+10% allowed) -> FAILED
```
jamal: ugh, that's the PR that touched kernel-autoselect + sampler heuristic, could be an affinity flip causing cold KV paths.
olivia: do we see kernel selector choosing a different kernel for the common seqlen? any flamegraph?
marie: attaching quick flame snippet from the shadow run (small excerpt):
```
- kernel::matmul (hot) 42%
- kv::lookup (was 8% -> now 22%)
- batcher::slot_wait 14%
```
alex: kv::lookup jumping that much points at increased cache misses or evictions during the new sampler. did you repro locally with the same seed?
marie: not yet. shadow job used the same trace as CI microbench harness. I'll try a local run later.
lin: if kv miss rate is up, maybe the batcher is coalescing differently and evicting keys earlier. the heuristic change reduced prefix aggregation window in some cases.
jamal: plan: 1) reproduce locally with microbench harness + perf counters, 2) run kernel-autoselect off (force previous kernel), 3) bisect sampler changes if needed. anyone object to holding the PR rollout until we confirm?
olivia: hold for now. this could be a rollout blocker for the next patch window. tag me if you need access to the repro infra. :eyes:
alex: quick mitigation idea: revert the sampler tweak and run a fast shadow. if that returns hitrate to baseline we can ship the revert and iterate.
marie: I'll start with forced-kernel run on CI and post results here. If that doesn't match, I'll bisect within the sampler commits.
perf-bot: triggered: ci/shadow/pr-21399/forced-kernel run queued (job id: shadow-8723).
marie: thanks — updating the PR with a hold flag and adding the perf diffs.
jamal: awesome, thanks. if we find a consistent repro I'll prepare a small test in the perf unit tests to catch this before merge.
olivia: please add the failing trace to the regression corpus if we can reproduce — good to have a golden. :+1:
marie: noted. will update after forced-kernel job completes.
